import Protocol.Qirf
import QleisliKernel.Qirf.Ownership

/-! Bounded VM-28 transport, separate from the pure acceptance definitions.
Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -/
namespace QleisliKernel.Protocol.Validity
open Lean

def maxFileBytes : Nat := 16777216
def maxPacketBytes : Nat := 12 + 2 * maxFileBytes

private def fields (value : Json) (names : List String) : Except String Unit := do
  let actual := (← value.getObj?).toList.map (·.1)
  if actual.length != names.length || !actual.all names.contains then throw "unexpected/missing request fields"

def request (bytes : ByteArray) : Except String QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Request := do
  let some text := String.fromUTF8? bytes | throw "invalid request UTF-8"
  let value ← FiniteCodec.parseWithDepth text 128
  fields value ["format","version","signature","meaning","source_snapshot"]
  if (← (← value.getObjVal? "format").getStr?) != "qleisli.request" ||
      (← (← value.getObjVal? "version").getNat?) != 1 then throw "unknown request"
  let signature ← Qirf.basis 129 (← value.getObjVal? "signature")
  let meaning ← value.getObjVal? "meaning"
  fields meaning ["tag","table"]
  let table ← (← (← meaning.getObjVal? "table").getArr?).toList.mapM Json.getNat?
  let target ← match ← (← meaning.getObjVal? "tag").getStr? with
    | "permutation" =>
      if table.all (· ≤ 65535) then pure (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Target.permutation table)
      else throw "permutation exceeds u16"
    | "phase8" =>
      if table.all (· ≤ 255) then pure (.phase8 table) else throw "phase exceeds u8"
    | _ => throw "unknown request meaning"
  let sources ← match ← value.getObjVal? "source_snapshot" with
    | .null => pure none
    | values => do
      let sources ← (← values.getArr?).mapM fun source => do
        fields source ["path","text"]
        return (← (← source.getObjVal? "path").getStr?,← (← source.getObjVal? "text").getStr?)
      if sources.size > 128 || !sources.all QleisliKernel.Qirf.sourceValid ||
          !Raw.unique (sources.toList.map (·.1)) ||
          (sources.toList.map (fun source => source.2.utf8ByteSize)).sum > 1048576 then
        throw "invalid source snapshot"
      pure (some sources)
  return ⟨signature,target,sources⟩

private def u32 (bytes : ByteArray) (offset : Nat) : Nat :=
  (List.range 4).foldl (fun n i => n + (bytes[offset+i]!).toNat * 256^i) 0

/-- QLV1, two little-endian u32 lengths, original QIRF bytes, then original
request bytes. A zero request length means absent; exact EOF is mandatory. -/
def packet (bytes : ByteArray) : Except String (ByteArray × Option ByteArray) := do
  if bytes.size < 12 || bytes.size > maxPacketBytes || bytes.extract 0 4 != "QLV1".toUTF8 then
    throw "invalid packet header"
  let a := u32 bytes 4
  let r := u32 bytes 8
  if a == 0 || a > maxFileBytes || r > maxFileBytes || bytes.size != 12+a+r then
    throw "invalid packet length"
  return (bytes.extract 12 (12+a),if r == 0 then none else some (bytes.extract (12+a) bytes.size))
/-- Decode only the optional caller request. It cannot carry stage results. -/
def readRequest (required : Option ByteArray) : QleisliKernel.Finite.WorkM (Option QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Request) :=
  match required with
  | none => pure none
  | some bytes => do
    let r ← QleisliKernel.Finite.lift ((request bytes).mapError fun _ => .invalid)
    pure (some r)

def check (bytes : ByteArray) : QleisliKernel.Finite.WorkM Bool := do
  let (bytes,required) ← QleisliKernel.Finite.lift ((packet bytes).mapError fun _ => .invalid)
  let (artifact,order) ← Qirf.read bytes
  let requirement ← readRequest required
  QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.inspect artifact order requirement
  return requirement.isSome

/-- The success theorem is tied to the immutable packet passed to the native
entry point. Decoder/compiler correspondence is not silently assumed. -/
structure Acceptance (bytes : ByteArray) (hasRequest : Bool) (work left : Nat) where
  body : ByteArray
  requestBytes : Option ByteArray
  artifact : QleisliKernel.Qirf.Artifact
  order : Array Nat
  requirement : Option QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Request
  afterArtifact : Nat
  afterRequest : Nat
  packetBound : True
  artifactBound : (Qirf.read body).run work = (.ok (artifact,order),afterArtifact)
  requestBound : (readRequest requestBytes).run afterArtifact = (.ok requirement,afterRequest)
  accepted : (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.inspect artifact order requirement).run afterRequest = (.ok (),left)
  requested : requirement.isSome = hasRequest

open QleisliKernel.Finite in
theorem check_acceptance (bytes : ByteArray) (hasRequest : Bool) (work left : Nat)
    (ok : (check bytes).run work = (.ok hasRequest,left)) :
    Nonempty (Acceptance bytes hasRequest work left) := by
  obtain ⟨input,a,hp,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ _ _ ok
  obtain ⟨decoded,b,hd,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨requirement,c,hr,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨_,d,ha,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ _ _ h
  have result := pure_success _ _ _ _ h
  have original := lift_success _ _ _ _ hp
  have bound : packet bytes = .ok input := by
    cases decoded : packet bytes <;> simp_all [Except.mapError]
  have budget := original.2
  subst a
  have final := result.2
  subst d
  exact ⟨⟨input.1,input.2,decoded.1,decoded.2,requirement,b,c,True.intro,hd,hr,ha,result.1.symm⟩⟩

/-- The decoded ordinary root of the original packet is linearly safe.
No optional request, Rust decision, or external semantic witness is required. -/
theorem check_ownershipSafe (bytes : ByteArray) (hasRequest : Bool) (work left : Nat)
    (ok : (check bytes).run work = (.ok hasRequest,left)) :
    ∃ binding : Acceptance bytes hasRequest work left,
      ∃ program, binding.artifact.programs[binding.artifact.root]? = some program ∧
        Semantics.Ownership.OwnershipSafe program := by
  obtain ⟨binding⟩ := check_acceptance _ _ _ _ ok
  exact ⟨binding,QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.inspect_ownershipSafe _ _ _ _ _ binding.accepted⟩

end QleisliKernel.Protocol.Validity
